units.output_text: And stay there for a bit.

units.source_text: Later, ask the fun question: what actually happened?
units.output_text: Later on, when you’re feeling good, you can get curious with yourself and wonder what it was about what the other person did or said that actually felt like a violation. Maybe they did do something violating.

units.source_text: Somebody may really have crossed a boundary and still have hit something old in you. You felt your stomach tighten up, and that somehow meant “They're evil.”
units.output_text: Maybe they triggered something in you.

units.source_text: But you can defer that judgement for when you're in your happy place.
units.output_text: But you don’t have to figure it out now in order to get out of the pit of your stomach and get into a happier place. You can always come back and decide later if this other person is actually evil or not.
